{
  "name": "game-loop-breaker",
  "displayName": "GAME MODE · Loop Breaker",
  "version": "0.1.1",
  "description": "Stops the same call failing the same way again and again: warns at LOOP 2/3, blocks the next identical run once sealed, lifts after a change or a new message",
  "author": {
    "name": "Reason of Moon",
    "url": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon/bitgame-mods/tree/main/plugins/game-loop-breaker",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon/bitgame-mods",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "game-mode",
    "loops",
    "retries",
    "guard"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mode",
      "description": "block refuses the next identical run once sealed; warn lets it run with a note; off stops counting. /loop-breaker changes it for later sessions too",
      "default": "block",
      "options": [
        "block",
        "warn",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Seal after",
      "description": "Identical failures in a row before the next identical run is blocked",
      "default": 3,
      "min": 2,
      "max": 10
    }
  }
}
